title: The frontend tells the user to "Select up to 12 countries" and rejects a thirteenth; DR1 puts no limit on how many countries a consignment travels through.

finding.frontend: The hint under "Select all countries the consignment will travel through" reads "Select up to 12 countries" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/transport/copy/copy.en.js:47-50), and it is enforced: the page holds a cap of twelve and rejects a thirteenth with "Select up to 12 countries" (transit-countries/transit-countries.controller.js:18 and :33-36). The list the user is choosing from is thirty-one countries long, so more than twelve is reachable.
finding.prototype: DR1 states no ceiling anywhere on the page — its hint is "Enter each country that the consignment will travel through" — and its handling of the answer normalises and stores whatever was added without counting it (app/routes.js:1910-1946).
finding.difference: Remove the cap and the hint that announces it. If a limit is genuinely wanted, it needs to be stated in DR1 first, because the number twelve appears nowhere in the signed-off design. This is one of two rules the frontend puts on this field that DR1 does not; the other is that it may not be empty.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a stated or enforced maximum number of transit countries in DR1 — its transit-country handling stores the normalised list without any length check.
finding.verification: Read both rendered DOMs and both full-page screenshots, read transit-countries.controller.js and copy.en.js whole, and read DR1's transit-countries.html and every transit-country function and route in app/routes.js. Ran the falsifier: DR1's POST handler at routes.js:10503-10537 parses the body, saves it and redirects with no length check anywhere, and normalizeTransitCountries only filters falsy entries, so it does not fire; no ceiling is stated on DR1's page either — its hint reads "Enter each country that the consignment will travel through". The frontend side is exact: MAX_TRANSITED_COUNTRIES = 12 at controller.js:18, the rejection at :33-37, and "Select up to 12 countries" appears both as the hint and as the error text at copy.en.js:49 and :52. Counted the frontend's checkbox group in the captured DOM: 31 inputs, so more than twelve is reachable. CORRECT.

relatedTo.why: the other rule the frontend puts on this field and DR1 does not
